ai_summary: **Executive Summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd. Share Buyback**  Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd. reported its daily share buyback activity on August 25, 2026, repurchasing 72,807 equity shares on the National Stock Exchange at an average price of ₹303.25 per share. This brings the cumulative total of shares bought back under the ongoing program to 632,351, signaling a strategic move to reduce outstanding shares and return capital to shareholders. The filing appears routine and does not present any immediate red flags.
